sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_search_fts" USING fts5(track_public_id UNINDEXED, title, artist, album, file_name, tokenize = 'trigram');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_roots" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "locator_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "recursive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("recursive" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "scan_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_scan_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_scan_completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_type", "locator_key"), CHECK (source_type = 'windowsDirectory'), CHECK (scan_generation >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan_runs" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "root_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_roots (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "discovered_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unchanged_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parsed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "inserted_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "missing_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "failure_message" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("root_id", "generation"), CHECK (generation >= 0), CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'enumerating', 'processing', 'committing', 'finalizing', 'completed', 'completedWithIssues', 'cancelled', 'failed')), CHECK (discovered_count >= 0), CHECK (unchanged_count >= 0), CHECK (parsed_count >= 0), CHECK (inserted_count >= 0), CHECK (updated_count >= 0), CHECK (missing_count >= 0), CHECK (failed_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_files" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "root_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_roots (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "locator_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extension" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "platform_file_id" TEXT NULL, "quick_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "availability_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seen_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "missing_since" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "last_error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("root_id", "locator_key"), CHECK (size_bytes >= 0), CHECK (last_seen_generation >= 0), CHECK (availability_state IN ('available', 'missing', 'unreadable')), CHECK (metadata_state IN ('pending', 'ready', 'failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artwork_assets" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "relative_cache_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed_at" INTEGER NULL, CHECK (byte_length >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artists" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "album_artist_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES artists (row_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "release_year" INTEGER NULL, "artwork_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES artwork_assets (row_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (release_year IS NULL OR release_year BETWEEN 1 AND 9999));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "media_file_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES media_files (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_artist" TEXT NULL, "display_album" TEXT NULL, "album_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES albums (row_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "bitrate_bps" INTEGER NULL, "sample_rate_hz" INTEGER NULL, "track_number" INTEGER NULL, "track_total" INTEGER NULL, "disc_number" INTEGER NULL, "disc_total" INTEGER NULL, "release_year" INTEGER NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "metadata_source" TEXT NULL, "metadata_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "artwork_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES artwork_assets (row_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms >= 0), CHECK (bitrate_bps IS NULL OR bitrate_bps >= 0), CHECK (sample_rate_hz IS NULL OR sample_rate_hz > 0), CHECK (track_number IS NULL OR track_number > 0), CHECK (track_total IS NULL OR track_total > 0), CHECK (disc_number IS NULL OR disc_number > 0), CHECK (disc_total IS NULL OR disc_total > 0), CHECK (release_year IS NULL OR release_year BETWEEN 1 AND 9999), CHECK (metadata_revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_artists" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "artist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artists (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id", "artist_id", "role"), CHECK (position >= 0), CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'performer')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_genres" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "genre_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES genres (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id", "genre_id"), CHECK (position >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite_tracks" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_playlists" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "public_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(normalized_name)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_playlist_items" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user_playlists (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("playlist_id", "track_id"), UNIQUE ("playlist_id", "position"), CHECK (position >= 0));
CREATE INDEX media_files_root_availability ON media_files (root_id, availability_state)
CREATE INDEX media_files_root_last_seen_generation ON media_files (root_id, last_seen_generation)
CREATE INDEX media_files_platform_file_id ON media_files (platform_file_id)
CREATE INDEX media_files_quick_fingerprint ON media_files (quick_fingerprint)
CREATE INDEX media_files_content_hash ON media_files (content_hash)
CREATE INDEX artists_sort_name ON artists (sort_name)
CREATE INDEX artists_name ON artists (name)
CREATE INDEX albums_sort_title ON albums (sort_title)
CREATE INDEX albums_album_artist_id ON albums (album_artist_id)
CREATE INDEX albums_artwork_id ON albums (artwork_id)
CREATE INDEX tracks_album_id ON tracks (album_id)
CREATE INDEX tracks_sort_title ON tracks (sort_title)
CREATE INDEX tracks_title ON tracks (title)
CREATE INDEX tracks_artwork_id ON tracks (artwork_id)
CREATE INDEX track_artists_artist_role_position ON track_artists (artist_id, role, position)
CREATE INDEX track_artists_track_position ON track_artists (track_id, position)
CREATE INDEX track_genres_genre_id ON track_genres (genre_id)
CREATE INDEX track_genres_track_position ON track_genres (track_id, position)
CREATE INDEX favorite_tracks_created_at ON favorite_tracks (created_at, track_id)
CREATE INDEX user_playlists_updated_at ON user_playlists (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX user_playlist_items_playlist_position ON user_playlist_items (playlist_id, position)
